name: CJ Seafood Corporation
summary: Headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea, CJ Seafood Corporation is a key player in the production and processing of seafood across the nation. Their extensive product line features fish cake, meat, seaweed, and a variety of refrigerated and frozen food items. These offerings are sold under the well-known Samho Fish Cake and Samho Masal brand names. In addition to its domestic market activities, the company actively exports its seafood products internationally. Founded in 1976, the enterprise operated as Samho F&G, Inc. until its rebranding to CJ Seafood Corporation in 2010.
